name: ayinbox
description: Run AY Inbox cold email from your agent: build lists, draft campaigns and the campaign brain, triage replies and draft answers, offer meeting times and report results, through the hosted AY Inbox MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connects the hosted AY Inbox MCP server and adds playbooks for building contact lists, drafting cold email campaigns and the campaign brain reply drafts read, triaging replies, offering meeting times from Cal.com or Calendly, and reporting results. The agent prepares; a person connects mailboxes, sends replies and starts campaigns.
defaultPrompt: Triage my new AY Inbox replies and draft answers for the interested ones
Write a weekly report on my active AY Inbox campaigns
Help me write the campaign brain for my offer before the first campaign
